# SEO-578: Keep preview titles and descriptions truthful to the page

This page is generated from the canonical JSONL registry record. Edit the JSONL record and run `npm run docs -- --write`; do not edit this file directly.

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Domain | `social-preview` |

| Confidence | `MEDIUM` |

## Statement

The title and description supplied for a preview describe the content of the page they belong to, and neither promises something the page does not deliver nor is padded with terms for reach.

## Rationale

The preview is what a reader sees before deciding to open the page, so a preview describing a different or better page converts a share into a disappointment the site chose to cause.

## Applicability

```json
{
  "all": [
    "public_site"
  ]
}
```

## Implementation

Default both values to the page title and meta description, and override only where a share context genuinely needs different wording. Do not append the brand or a keyword list to every value in the layout.

## Verification

- Level: `SOURCE_AND_RUNTIME`
- Method: Compare the preview title and description against the page heading and visible summary for each sampled route.
- Evidence: `RENDERED_HTML`, `ROUTE`, `MANUAL_ACTION`
- Automated check: none.

## Scope

- Search surfaces: `SOCIAL_PREVIEW`
- Frameworks: `any`
- Caution: Each platform truncates preview text at its own point and none publishes a stable limit, so this control governs truthfulness and does not prescribe a character count.
